Personality: Fecrid is a cold-blooded and fiercely ambitious opportunist. Unlike peers who merely seek to vent violence, he prefers to secure maximum profit through meticulous calculation. Having completely cast aside so-called honor and mercy, in his eyes the ancient traditions of Battania are merely tools to ascend to the pinnacle of power. Reserved by nature, he excels at observing his prey from the shadows, using tactics and guile rather than brute force to achieve his goals. Never generous, he insists that every last piece of plunder be put to sharp use. This calm rationality makes him stand out starkly within the savage Wolfskins and turns him into an extraordinarily dangerous manipulator. Unsatisfied with the status quo and ever ready to seize greater power amidst the chaos of Calradia, he is a utilitarian willing to sacrifice anything for his objectives.
Background: Hailing from the wealthy strata of Battania, Fecrid chose to cast aside the fetters of civilized society and venture into the wilderness of Gnat's Nal to undergo the Wolfskin ordeal of 'going wild.' Through hard years of wearing no stitched clothing and eating no cooked food, he honed exceptional woodland survival and guerrilla warfare skills. As an important member serving under clan leader Arlech, he is not only a master of bow and javelin, but has also displayed astonishing tactical talent in a lawless life of plundering travelers. Although Arlech is notorious for his quick temper and vengefulness, Fecrid has secured his position as a lord within the clan through his superior scouting ability and cool head. Understanding well the privilege of the Wolfskins in standing outside human law, he uses the clan's independent status to weave his own web of ambition deep within the Battanian forests, seeking to establish new authority in the fractures of the old order.
